advice.text: Fronts saturate under braking before turn-in: brake pressure DOWN toward the knee, then balance 2-3% rearward.
advice.evidence: 34/36 corners red on the fronts in phase 1

advice.text: Mid-corner understeer: front ARB -2 clicks or front springs softer (mech balance up); if only in fast corners, aero balance forward instead.
advice.evidence: USI median +0.286 over 36 corners (21 understeer, 0 mid-corner front reds)

advice.text: Fronts run 15 F+ hotter than rears: the understeer thermal signature — check pressures/camber on the HUD (Tires Misc + Heat).
advice.evidence: median F 226 F vs R 202 F

advice.text: Suspension hits full compression at speed: ride height up a notch or springs stiffer (verify on the HUD Suspension page).
advice.evidence: 9 bottoming frames above 40 mph (detector still coarse)

advice.text: Brake-lock pattern inconsistent across 17 stops (1 both-axle, 5 front-first, 0 rear-first) — more hard stops from 80+ mph before touching balance.
Balance varies corner to corner (USI spread 0.49) — likely speed-dependent (mechanical vs aero). Split the verdict by corner speed before tuning.
